about: See who qualifies for the 10-year Blue Residence for environmental and sustainability work.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Blue Residence guide. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: 10-year renewable residence with no sponsor, for people who contribute to environmental protection and sustainability
Categories: environmental influencers, scientists and researchers, investors and entrepreneurs, inventors and innovators, and elite specialists in environmental organisations
Investors need fully owned capital of at least 2 million AED; entrepreneurs an SME with at least 1 million AED annual revenue
Golden Residence holders can convert if they meet the requirements
Family members (spouse, children of any age, parents) can get 10-year permits
documents: Passport valid for more than 6 months
Other papers depend on the category, such as recommendation letters, publications or business plans
fees: The guide page states no fee amounts
timing: The guide page gives no timing
channels: Blue Residence services on the ICP Smart Services platform
Nomination by a relevant authority, which applies for the person
